top.line: Four uses of a feature behaviour policy, on real things.
top.para: A key, the factory's CI, requests, release notes.

in-short.line: A real key's gap; a signed policy for CI changes; requests carrying policies; release notes as fixes' policies.

key.line: A Google key's reach is five APIs on four hosts; the replays feature needs one; one row has a real boundary.
key.para: The rest are settings and expectations.

factory.line: A short signed policy for the factory's CI changes, enforced by the agent that runs it.

requests.line: Requests carry the signed policies they act under, so servers and observers can check them.

fixes.line: Three of today's fixes as bug behaviour policies: what each closed, kept and must not open.

limits.line: Read from the team's brief; the factory policy is a proposal; request signing not built.

sources.line: PrompTugal's Google APIs brief and register, and this newsroom's signed-commit notes and releases.
